name: Asian-American Tobacco Use by Ethnicity
description: Smoking status by ethnicity for 14,021 Asian-American adults (Asian-Indian, Chinese, Filipino). IMS Ch. 18.
studyDescription: Survey responses from 14,021 Asian-American adults recording each respondent's ethnicity (Asian-Indian, Chinese, or Filipino) and whether they smoke. This is an observational survey disaggregating tobacco use across Asian-American subgroups.

variableDescriptions.ethnicity: The respondent's self-identified ethnicity: Asian-Indian, Chinese, or Filipino.
variableDescriptions.outcome: Whether the respondent smokes or does not smoke.

sourceDetail: OpenIntro IMS Ch. 18. Based on Rao et al. (2021), disaggregated Asian-American tobacco-use data.

context.parameter: association between ethnicity and smoking status
context.nullClaim: ethnicity and smoking status are independent
